steps.en: After upload, OCMS runs the checks automatically in real time per row
steps.id: Setelah upload, OCMS langsung menjalankan pengecekan otomatis per baris

steps.en: OCMS checks the payment status of each notice
steps.id: OCMS mengecek status pembayaran tiap notice
steps.why_en: Payment status shows, but unpaid is a dash and no payment date is shown.
steps.why_id: Status bayar tampil, tapi belum bayar hanya strip dan tanggal bayar tidak ada.

steps.en: OCMS checks PLUS for any appeal received for the notice
steps.id: OCMS mengecek ke PLUS apakah ada appeal untuk notice
steps.why_en: No check goes to PLUS; only the suspension reason PLUS left in OCMS is shown.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pengecekan ke PLUS; hanya alasan suspension dari PLUS yang tampil.

steps.en: The result shows date appealed, appeal status and appeal reply date
steps.id: Hasil memuat tanggal appeal, status appeal, dan tanggal reply
steps.why_en: None of the three appeal fields exists in the result.
steps.why_id: Ketiga data appeal tidak ada di hasil.

steps.en: The check results are shown on screen for the officer to review
steps.id: Hasil pengecekan tampil di layar untuk direview officer
steps.why_en: The screen works but lacks the appeal data.
steps.why_id: Layar sudah ada tapi tanpa data appeal.
